items.name: agent-queue
items.title: Agent Queue
items.description: An agent work queue: one lane per agent with the run in progress, what comes next and why it waits, and what waits for a person. Use it for an agents overview page. Presentational: map runs from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/runs and issues from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to AgentQueueData.
items.docs: Purely presentational: pass AgentQueueData (lanes built from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents runs and @nocobase/app-plugin-projects issues), the viewer, issueHref and onNavigate, and labels from your locale resources (English by default).

items.name: agent-run-history
items.title: Agent Run History
items.description: An agent's runs on one subject: a compact side-column log with a live timer, an all-runs dialog, the live pill, an activity row, a run's transcript and its brief. Use it beside a record agents work on. Presentational: map SubjectRun and Run from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents to AgentRunHistoryRun.
items.docs: Map your runs to AgentRunHistoryRun (newest first) and their events to RunTranscriptEvent; runHref and onOpenRun open a run, onStop and onRetry report actions for you to confirm and perform. Every word comes from the labels props, English by default.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent Composer
items.description: The message box for talking to an agent: page-context chips inside it, files to send (attach, paste, drop, uploaded before sending), Enter to send, Stop while the agent works, and a toolbar slot for a model or mode picker. Use it wherever a person writes to an agent. Presentational: context chips, drafts and focus come from the agents plugin's chat hooks (@nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat) through optional props.
items.docs: Pass onSend (return true, or a promise of true, once the message is taken), and optionally running, onStop, toolbar and notice; pass attachments (upload, and optionally discard and registerAdd; useChatAttachments of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat uploads to the plugin) to send files; wire context (chips from contextChips and buildPageContext of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat), draft and registerFocus from the chat panel when it sits in one. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

items.name: agent-picker
items.title: Agent Picker
items.description: The one way to pick an agent: a trigger with the agent's avatar (availability dot on its corner) and name, and a menu of the agents grouped by type (Online, Runner) with their default and personal tags and availability. Two appearances: field, which looks like a form's select, for forms and settings; toolbar, compact with the mode tag, for a composer. Presentational: pass ChatAgent records from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/shared/conversations.
items.docs: Pass the agents (useChatAgents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat for chat, or useAgentOptions().agents from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/kit for a form), value and onSelect. appearance is field by default (type filters to Online or Runner, noneOption offers no agent, placeholder, disabled, id for a label); appearance='toolbar' fits a composer, and bound marks an existing conversation, whose agent cannot change. Also exports AgentIdentity (avatar, dot and name as one row, for a picker that lists agents among people), AvailabilityDot, ModeTag, AgentTags and AgentTag. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent Chat
items.description: The agents' chat: a side panel beside the content area with the conversation, live steps, a composer with page-context chips and files to send (attach, paste, drop), model and agent pickers, the history, a full-page conversation view, and header, floating and Ask agent launchers. Use it to let people talk to agents from any page. Wired to the headless hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat.
items.docs: Requires the agents plugin (and the file plugin on the server for files sent in chat): wrap the routes in ChatProvider from @nocobase/app-plugin-agents/client/chat (pass conversationPath when ChatConversationPage has a route such as /chat/:conversationId), optionally with ChatExtensionsContext for cards among the messages. Render ChatPanel as a sibling of <main> inside a `relative flex` row, ChatHeaderButton in the header and ChatFloatingButton anywhere; add the plugin's chatLinkRoutes(base) for links that open the panel; spread locales/ into client/locales/.
